svg.aria-label: Dhruvil Dhamecha — Software Engineer, Java and Full Stack Developer, Open Source Contributor, AI learner and Cyber Security Vigilante
svg.title: Dhruvil Dhamecha — Software Engineer & Cyber Security Vigilante
svg.desc: Animated Daredevil-themed hero: the Man Without Fear stands in blood-red rain that falls behind him over a Hell’s Kitchen skyline, beside the name Dhruvil Dhamecha and typed roles — Java developer, full stack developer, open source contributor, cyber security vigilante.

g.text: a devil in the code, a guardian in the dark.
I don't see the bugs. I hear them.
